name: Mimic

source.note: Numbers from the SRD 5.2.1 Mimic (the 2025 Monster Manual block); not yet compared line by line with the book.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.summary: In object form it sticks to anything that touches it; a Huge or smaller creature stuck to it is Grappled (escape DC 13, with Disadvantage).
traits.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Bite

damage.when: extra, against a target the mimic has Grappled (12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing in all)

actions.summary: Bites for piercing plus acid damage, harder against a creature it holds.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic, plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.summary: Slams a target for bludgeoning plus acid damage; a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13).
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the shape of a Medium or Small object, or returns to its true blob form.
bonus_actions.text: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

summary: Waits as a door or a chest until someone touches it, then holds them fast and bites.
